backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the GenMitra print platform backend, defining data types (products, orders, users, templates, cart) and stable storage maps, with admin/demo seeding on upgrade hooks and mixed-in authorization and blob storage.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report specifying that the product listing grid section must be completely removed from `frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx` while all other homepage sections remain intact.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON document containing short summaries of all frontend source files, describing the purpose and recent changes of each component, page, and hook in the project.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS entry point that imports Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens used throughout the UI.
frontend/index.html: HTML shell for the React SPA, setting the page title to 'GenMitra Print Platform', configuring a Content Security Policy for iframe sources, and mounting the app at `#root`.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Defines the TanStack Router route tree with all public and admin routes, wraps the app in QueryClientProvider and Toaster, and enforces admin authentication via AdminGuard.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminGuard: Route guard component that redirects unauthenticated users to the login page and shows a loading spinner while the admin session is being verified.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminLayou: Admin panel shell with a responsive sidebar navigation (Dashboard, Products, Templates, Orders, Settings), logout, and back-to-store actions, rendering child routes via Outlet.
Displays a customer reviews section with an overall rating summary, star breakdown bars, and a paginated single-review card with navigation arrows and a sort dropdown.
frontend/src/components/FAQSection.tsx: Renders a two-column accordion FAQ section with six predefined questions about photo frames, toggling answers open/closed via Plus/Minus icons.
frontend/src/components/FeaturedProducts: Displays a responsive product grid fetched from the backend (falling back to demo data), supporting category and search filtering with loading skeletons and an empty-state view.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders a dark four-column site footer with brand info, navigation links for company, support, and legal sections, plus a bottom copyright bar.
frontend/src/components/FrameStyleDropdo: A custom dropdown component for selecting a photo frame style, displaying thumbnail images and names for five predefined frame options with outside-click dismissal.
frontend/src/components/HeroBanner.tsx: A full-width hero banner with a gradient background, headline text, and two CTA buttons navigating to the shop and photo frames category, alongside a hero image.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main app layout component providing a sticky header with logo, search bar, authenticated user controls (profile, orders, cart, logout), and an Outlet for child routes.
frontend/src/components/OffersBanner.tsx: A promotional banner section displaying a limited-time 20% discount offer with a promo code and a CTA button linking to the homepage.
frontend/src/components/ProductCategoryG: Renders a grid of product category buttons (Photo Prints, Frames, Magnets, Mugs, Corporate Gifts) with icons that navigate to the home page filtered by category.
frontend/src/components/ShopFramesBySize: Displays a grid of photo frame size options (4×6 to 20×24 inches) with images, each navigating to the Photo Frames category on click.
frontend/src/components/TrustFeatures.ts: Renders a horizontal bar of four trust/feature highlights (Free Delivery, Secure Payment, Easy Returns, 24/7 Support) with icons and subtitles.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) using React Query, reinitializing and invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminSession.ts: Hook managing admin session state via sessionStorage with hardcoded credential validation, exposing login, logout, and authentication status.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuth.ts: Thin auth hook combining Internet Identity state with the caller's user profile query, exposing identity, login/logout, and profile data.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider and useInternetIdentity hook that manage DFINITY AuthClient lifecycle, identity persistence, and login/logout state.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes all React Query hooks for backend interactions including products, templates, cart, and orders CRUD operations via the ICP actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports Google Fonts and Tailwind, defines CSS custom properties for light/dark themes using oklch colors, and adds utility component classes like btn-primary and card-amazon.
frontend/src/lib/demoProducts.ts: Exports a static array of demo ProductInfo objects covering categories like Photo Prints, Photo Frames, and Photo Magnets with preset prices, sizes, image paths, and delivery times.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that mounts the App component wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider into the DOM root.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminDashboardP: Admin dashboard showing summary stats (orders, earnings, users, products) and a table of the five most recent orders with status badges and navigation to the full orders list.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminSettingsPa: Admin settings page for managing delivery pincodes, allowing admins to add or remove 6-digit pincodes via form inputs with toast notifications for feedback.
frontend/src/pages/admin/CustomerManagem: Lists all registered customers in expandable rows; clicking a row lazily fetches and displays that customer's order history.
frontend/src/pages/admin/OrderManagement: Admin order management page with search and status filtering, expandable order rows, and actions to update order status, download custom images, and generate or download production files.
frontend/src/pages/admin/ProductManageme: Admin page for managing products with full CRUD operations, including a search filter, modal form for create/edit, image compression utility, and size options management.
frontend/src/pages/admin/TemplateManagem: Admin page for managing print templates with CRUD operations, image upload with compression, and fields for photo slots and DPI settings.
frontend/src/pages/CartPage.tsx: Shopping cart page that displays cart items with quantities and pricing, supports item removal and cart clearing, and calculates subtotal, shipping, tax, and total with navigation to checkout.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx: Two-step checkout page (address then payment) that collects shipping address and payment method, then creates an order and navigates to an order confirmation page.
frontend/src/pages/CreateAccountPage.tsx: Account creation page with username and email fields that triggers Internet Identity login on form submission and links to the sign-in page.
frontend/src/pages/EditorPage.tsx: Canvas-based photo editor page allowing users to upload, drag, zoom, rotate, and frame images with undo/redo history, size/orientation selection, and add-to-cart functionality.
frontend/src/pages/ForgotPasswordPage.ts: Renders a forgot-password form that accepts an email address and simulates sending reset instructions, then shows a confirmation screen with a back-to-login button.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Main landing page that conditionally renders search results or category-filtered products based on URL params, otherwise displays the full homepage with banner, categories, offers, reviews, and FAQ sections.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login page supporting two modes—customer login via Internet Identity and admin login via username/password—with appropriate error handling and post-login navigation.
frontend/src/pages/MyOrdersPage.tsx: Displays a list of the authenticated user's orders with status badges and product thumbnails, handling loading, error, and empty states with navigation to order details.
frontend/src/pages/OrderConfirmationPage: Shows a success screen after order placement, displaying order ID, total, payment method, and estimated delivery fetched by order ID, with links to track the order or continue shopping.
frontend/src/pages/OrderDetailPage.tsx: Renders detailed information for a single order including a step-by-step status timeline, order items with images, and address/payment details fetched via the order ID route param.
frontend/src/pages/ProductDetailPage.tsx: Displays a product detail page with image, size selection, quantity, and a 'Start Customizing' button that navigates to the editor. Falls back to demo product data if the backend product is unavailable.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Renders a user profile dashboard with a sidebar for navigating panels (orders, wishlist, addresses, etc.) and an editable personal information panel with inline form controls.
frontend/src/utils/imageHelpers.ts: Utility function `getImageSrc` that normalizes various image data formats (data URIs, HTTP URLs, relative paths, raw base64) into a valid image src string.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage fallback support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom colors, fonts, border radii, box shadows, animations, and plugins (tailwindcss-animate, typography, container-queries) for the frontend.
project_state.json: Project state snapshot (version 73) documenting the full-stack architecture, known issues, existing features, admin credentials, and deployment targets for the online printing platform.
